onChange.template: [Category: player] Apply the Heroic Adventurer art style to the player character. Bold armor, warm tones, confident stance. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.

[Category: player] Apply the Sleek Operative art style to the player character. Dark tactical suit, cool metallic accents, minimal silhouette. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.
[Category: player] Apply the Rugged Explorer art style to the player character. Worn gear, earthy tones, practical equipment. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/player/category.schema.json, set pc_movement_style to {{pc_movement_style}}]
Set the player movement style to {{pc_movement_style}}. Kinematic = responsive KCC movement; Force-Based = physics momentum via addForce.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/player/category.schema.json, set pc_strafe_mode to {{pc_strafe_mode}}]
Set strafeMode on MovementAbility to {{pc_strafe_mode}}. On = character faces camera direction; Off = character faces movement direction.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/player/category.schema.json, set pc_slide_lock to {{pc_slide_lock}}]
Set slideDirectionLockEnabled on MovementAbility to {{pc_slide_lock}}. On = locks movement direction on start to prevent drift.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/player/category.schema.json, set pc_acceleration to {{pc_acceleration}}]
Set acceleration profile to {{pc_acceleration}}. Instant = enableAcceleration false; Smooth = accelerationTime 0.1; Gradual = accelerationTime 0.3.

action.template: Add a new player character variant to the player module.
Rebalance the player character movement and jump stats for a better game feel.
